column1: # Expressions whose results Node 24.21.0 prints differently on x86-64 and arm64 Linux, with each one's output
# (expression, linux-x64, linux-arm64; tab-separated), from Node's official binaries (the arm64 one under qemu-aarch64).
# Node's arm64 build fuses multiply-adds in V8's C++ (GCC's default -ffp-contract=fast); x86-64's has no FMA.
# Sections whose heading says the Nodes differ have different outputs on each line.
# math: inputs where one fused site alone changes the result (the site harness), x86-64 and arm64 Node differ
# math: inputs of the 2.4M-input run where x86-64 and arm64 Node differ, 5 per function
# pinned: the CI's failures and the residual cases of #pragma clang fp contract(fast)
# parseInt: other radixes, digits accumulated in parts of 32 bits (V8's HandleGenericCase), x86-64 and arm64 Node differ
# Date: MakeDate's day * msPerDay + time, fused on arm64, where a huge day count cancels a time (V8's MakeDate)
# arch-independent: parseInt skips leading zeros before it groups digits into parts (V8), same on both Nodes
